notes: the school: count is how many sardines the face holds, size is a body length in tank units (x the tuner's fishSize). bg is the tank's BACKGROUND — the water behind the bodies, per card, and the first thing that says whether a card is a red suit or a black one. The tuner's tankBg scales all of them at once. colGap/rowGap scale this card's pip formation and padX/padY its seat padding (world units); blank means the tuner's pipColGap/pipRowGap/fishPadX/fishPadY. drop biases the formation down the card, rotate leans every body and rotateVary scatters each around that lean — blank means pipDrop/pipRotate/pipRotateVary. All of them are signed, so blank and 0 are different answers. The panel's card rows write them

every number card is a school of its suit's fish, as many bodies as the rank — the count IS the number; no pips are drawn. Small-fish pool: sardine clownfish tang brownfish surgeonfish tunafish fish2 puffer
